description: Wind forecast verification: compares wind speed and direction forecasts against matched observation rows. Bias, MAE, RMSE, ensemble coverage for speed, and lead-time diagnostics over the selected window. Internal use only.

panels.title: Wind speed metrics
panels.description: Bias = AVG(forecast - observed); MAE = AVG(abs(error)); RMSE = sqrt(AVG(error^2)); In-envelope = observations between windspdlb and windspdub. 'Ensemble mean' uses windspdmean; 'NBM' uses windspd. Observations sourced from obs_wspd_kt on model_1 fhr=0 rows.

targets.rawSql:
WITH src AS (
  SELECT
    windspdmean - obs_wspd_kt AS err_mean,
    windspd     - obs_wspd_kt AS err_nbm,
    obs_wspd_kt AS observed_value,
    windspdlb   AS forecast_lb,
    windspdub   AS forecast_ub
  FROM v_wind_verification
  WHERE windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    AND obs_wspd_kt IS NOT NULL
    AND group_id = '$group'
    AND locname = '$location'
    AND model = '$model'
    AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
    AND lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
    AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")
)
SELECT 'Ensemble mean' AS "Source",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE err_mean IS NOT NULL) AS "N",
       AVG(err_mean)                    AS "Bias (kt)",
       AVG(ABS(err_mean))               AS "MAE (kt)",
       SQRT(AVG(err_mean * err_mean))   AS "RMSE (kt)",
       AVG(CASE WHEN observed_value BETWEEN forecast_lb AND forecast_ub THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)
         FILTER (WHERE forecast_lb IS NOT NULL AND forecast_ub IS NOT NULL) AS "In-envelope"
FROM src
UNION ALL
SELECT 'NBM',
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE err_nbm IS NOT NULL),
       AVG(err_nbm),
       AVG(ABS(err_nbm)),
       SQRT(AVG(err_nbm * err_nbm)),
       NULL::float
FROM src

panels.title: Wind direction metrics
panels.description: Direction error uses shortest signed angular difference, so +/-180 deg is the largest possible miss. 'Ensemble mean' uses winddirmean; 'NBM' uses winddir. Observations sourced from obs_wdir_degrees on model_1 fhr=0 rows.

targets.rawSql:
WITH src AS (
  SELECT
    (MOD((winddirmean - obs_wdir_degrees + 540)::numeric, 360) - 180)::float AS err_mean,
    (MOD((winddir     - obs_wdir_degrees + 540)::numeric, 360) - 180)::float AS err_nbm
  FROM v_wind_verification
  WHERE winddirmean IS NOT NULL
    AND obs_wdir_degrees IS NOT NULL
    AND group_id = '$group'
    AND locname = '$location'
    AND model = '$model'
    AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
    AND lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
    AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")
)
SELECT 'Ensemble mean' AS "Source",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE err_mean IS NOT NULL) AS "N",
       AVG(err_mean)                  AS "Circular bias (deg)",
       AVG(ABS(err_mean))             AS "MAE (deg)",
       SQRT(AVG(err_mean * err_mean)) AS "RMSE (deg)"
FROM src
UNION ALL
SELECT 'NBM',
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE err_nbm IS NOT NULL),
       AVG(err_nbm),
       AVG(ABS(err_nbm)),
       SQRT(AVG(err_nbm * err_nbm))
FROM src

panels.title: Daily wind speed Bias and MAE

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', "timestamp") AS "time",
       AVG(windspdmean - obs_wspd_kt) AS "Bias (mean)",
       AVG(ABS(windspdmean - obs_wspd_kt)) AS "MAE (mean)",
       AVG(windspd - obs_wspd_kt) AS "Bias (NBM)",
       AVG(ABS(windspd - obs_wspd_kt)) AS "MAE (NBM)"
FROM v_wind_verification
WHERE windspdmean IS NOT NULL
  AND obs_wspd_kt IS NOT NULL
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND model = '$model'
  AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
  AND lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
  AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Daily wind direction Bias and MAE

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', "timestamp") AS "time",
       AVG((MOD((winddirmean - obs_wdir_degrees + 540)::numeric, 360) - 180)::float) AS "Circular bias (mean)",
       AVG(ABS((MOD((winddirmean - obs_wdir_degrees + 540)::numeric, 360) - 180)::float)) AS "MAE (mean)",
       AVG((MOD((winddir - obs_wdir_degrees + 540)::numeric, 360) - 180)::float) AS "Circular bias (NBM)",
       AVG(ABS((MOD((winddir - obs_wdir_degrees + 540)::numeric, 360) - 180)::float)) AS "MAE (NBM)"
FROM v_wind_verification
WHERE winddirmean IS NOT NULL
  AND obs_wdir_degrees IS NOT NULL
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND model = '$model'
  AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
  AND lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
  AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Wind speed MAE by lead-time bucket

targets.rawSql:
SELECT lead_bucket,
       AVG(ABS(windspdmean - obs_wspd_kt)) AS mae
FROM v_wind_verification
WHERE windspdmean IS NOT NULL
  AND obs_wspd_kt IS NOT NULL
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND model = '$model'
  AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
  AND lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
  AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")
GROUP BY lead_bucket
ORDER BY CASE lead_bucket WHEN '0-6h' THEN 0 WHEN '6-12h' THEN 1 WHEN '12-24h' THEN 2 WHEN '24-48h' THEN 3 WHEN '48-72h' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

panels.title: Wind direction MAE by lead-time bucket

targets.rawSql:
SELECT lead_bucket,
       AVG(ABS((MOD((winddirmean - obs_wdir_degrees + 540)::numeric, 360) - 180)::float)) AS mae
FROM v_wind_verification
WHERE winddirmean IS NOT NULL
  AND obs_wdir_degrees IS NOT NULL
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND model = '$model'
  AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
  AND lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
  AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")
GROUP BY lead_bucket
ORDER BY CASE lead_bucket WHEN '0-6h' THEN 0 WHEN '6-12h' THEN 1 WHEN '12-24h' THEN 2 WHEN '24-48h' THEN 3 WHEN '48-72h' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

panels.title: Matched sample count by lead bucket

targets.rawSql:
SELECT lead_bucket AS "Lead bucket",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE obs_wspd_kt IS NOT NULL) AS "Wind speed pairs",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE obs_wdir_degrees IS NOT NULL) AS "Wind direction pairs"
FROM v_wind_verification
WHERE windspdmean IS NOT NULL
  AND (obs_wspd_kt IS NOT NULL OR obs_wdir_degrees IS NOT NULL)
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND model = '$model'
  AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
  AND lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
  AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")
GROUP BY lead_bucket
ORDER BY CASE lead_bucket WHEN '0-6h' THEN 0 WHEN '6-12h' THEN 1 WHEN '12-24h' THEN 2 WHEN '24-48h' THEN 3 WHEN '48-72h' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

SELECT "timestamp" AS "time",
       windspdmean AS "Forecast (mean)",
       windspd     AS "Forecast (NBM)",
       obs_wspd_kt AS "Observed",
       windspdlb   AS "Wind speed (lower bound)",
       windspdub   AS "Wind speed (upper bound)"
FROM v_wind_verification
WHERE windspdmean IS NOT NULL
  AND obs_wspd_kt IS NOT NULL
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND model = '$model'
  AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
  AND lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
  AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")
ORDER BY "timestamp"

WITH src AS (
  SELECT "timestamp" AS "time",
         winddirmean AS "Forecast (mean)",
         winddir     AS "Forecast (NBM)",
         obs_wdir_degrees AS "Observed"
  FROM v_wind_verification
  WHERE winddirmean IS NOT NULL
    AND obs_wdir_degrees IS NOT NULL
    AND group_id = '$group'
    AND locname = '$location'
    AND model = '$model'
    AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
    AND lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
    AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")
)
SELECT w."time",
       w.v1_s0 AS "Forecast (mean)", w.v1_sm1 AS "Forecast (mean)_sm1", w.v1_sp1 AS "Forecast (mean)_sp1",
       w.v2_s0 AS "Forecast (NBM)", w.v2_sm1 AS "Forecast (NBM)_sm1", w.v2_sp1 AS "Forecast (NBM)_sp1",
       w.v3_s0 AS "Observed", w.v3_sm1 AS "Observed_sm1", w.v3_sp1 AS "Observed_sp1"
FROM public.fn_wrap_directions(
  (SELECT array_agg("time"            ORDER BY "time") FROM src),
  (SELECT array_agg("Forecast (mean)" ORDER BY "time") FROM src),
  (SELECT array_agg("Forecast (NBM)"  ORDER BY "time") FROM src),
  (SELECT array_agg("Observed"        ORDER BY "time") FROM src)
) w
ORDER BY w."time"
